name: Indian National Congress
contribution: The Congress was a central anti-colonial party that shaped constitutional negotiations, mass mobilization, and debates over representation in Bengal and all-India politics.
context: Swadeshi era agitation, late-colonial provincial politics, and transfer-of-power negotiations.
impact: Its political strategy in Bengal and at the all-India level influenced both resistance to partition plans and the eventual constitutional settlement of 1947.
seoDescription: Profile of Indian National Congress, tracing connections to the 1947 Partition, Eastern Bengal, and related political-cultural history.
